children: Ryan Cohen, a director and the President, CEO and Chairman, reported a purchase of GameStop Class A common stock on September 21, 2026. The filing shows a weighted average purchase price of $22.9375 per share for the transactions. The total purchase amount reported is $26,393,722. Following the purchase, Cohen directly owns 40,498,522 Class A common shares. The filing notes the shares were purchased in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $22.7600 to $23.0200 and that the reporting person will provide details of the number of shares purchased at each price upon request.
